issues.feedback: The spec explicitly makes `.ralph/projects/<id>/state.json` / PRD usage out of scope, but the feature constraints require using available project metadata and referencing the generating project. As written, it only uses `DaemonTask` issue metadata and does not meet that requirement.

`edit_pr(owner, repo, branch, ...)` is underspecified and risky. `gh pr edit` should target a concrete PR identifier (URL/number). Branch-based targeting can be ambiguous; use the URL returned by `find_existing_pr` for deterministic updates.

The 80-character title rule is not precisely defined. The truncation algorithm must guarantee final length <= 80 (including ellipsis), count characters (not bytes), and normalize/remove newlines to avoid invalid multiline PR titles.

PR body generation has no size limits. Full issue body + full `git diff --stat` can exceed GitHub/CLI or OS argv limits and cause `gh pr create/edit` failures. Add truncation/capping rules and prefer `--body-file` for large bodies.

`git diff --stat <base>...HEAD` only summarizes committed changes. Current flow can detect diffs from working-tree state; this can yield empty/misleading `## Changes` while still creating a PR. The spec should define behavior for that mismatch.

The proposed tests miss key non-happy paths: `gh pr edit` failure should be non-blocking and must not trigger duplicate create; `diff_stat` failure fallback should be validated; end-to-end enforcement of title <= 80 should be asserted; and no-context/legacy task body formatting should be covered.
Constraints mention changes in `src/daemon/mod.rs`, but the plan targets `src/daemon/runtime.rs`. This mismatch should be resolved explicitly to avoid implementation churn and review confusion.
